name: minimax-subagents
description: MiniMax subagents and tiered workers on the M Plan / Token Plan subscription, run inline from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity (Agy) and Gemini CLI through MiniMax Code (mcode exec, default backend, OAuth with no key on disk) or OpenCode. Ships mm-run (backend auto/mcode/opencode, tier/effort routing, thinking stripped, transient retry, one OpenCode retry when mcode breaks, quota fallback exit 75, parallel cap), mm_fast/mm_m3/mm_flash worker lanes via smart-sub-agents, Claude/Agy bridge agents, and a one-shot cross-harness installer. Use when delegating coding, refactor, docs, long-context or multimodal work to MiniMax-M3.1-Flash-Preview, MiniMax-M3 or MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed.
